reason: The free part is the bit I'd actually want: ranges instead of a fake 28-day guess and a PDF for my doctor, since my period is six weeks late and I'm trying to get pregnant. Pro is mostly an AI write-up and chat, which is exactly what I don't want, and I've quit every tracker I've tried within a few weeks, so I'm not paying for one before I know I'll keep logging.
objection: I don't want another AI chatbot giving me health advice, especially about fertility. And honestly I'll probably stop logging in three weeks like I always do, so paying monthly feels like paying for homework.
would_change_my_mind: If I'd actually kept logging on the free version for two or three months and Pro gave me something concrete for trying to conceive, like ovulation likelihood with PCOS or something my OB said was useful, not just AI commentary.
